items.question: How does Lovart's poster design tool work?
items.answer: Simply describe your event or promotion, target audience, key information, and preferred aesthetic direction. Our AI Design Agent creates custom poster designs that effectively communicate your message while maximizing visual impact. You can then refine the design through natural conversation until it perfectly achieves your communication goals.

items.question: What makes Lovart different from template-based poster tools?
items.answer: Unlike rigid templates, our AI creates completely custom poster designs for each project. The system understands communication principles and creates layouts that strategically present your specific information rather than forcing your content into a one-size-fits-all template. This results in truly unique, message-driven designs that stand out from template-based posters.

items.question: Can I incorporate my organization's branding into the poster designs?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can specify your organization's colors, logos, typography, and brand guidelines, and our AI will incorporate them into each poster while ensuring your brand identity remains strong. This maintains consistent branding while allowing for event-specific customization across different promotions.

items.question: What types of posters can I create?
items.answer: Our system can create designs for any poster type including event promotions, movie posters, concert announcements, product launches, educational information, conference materials, political campaigns, retail promotions, and more. Each design adapts to the specific communication requirements and visual conventions of your particular poster purpose.

items.question: Are the poster designs optimized for both print and digital use?
items.answer: Yes! Each design is created with both formats in mind. You'll receive files optimized for traditional printing with proper resolution and dimensions for large-format production, as well as digital-ready versions specifically formatted for social media sharing, email marketing, and digital display.

items.question: How quickly can I create a professional poster design?
items.answer: Most users create their perfect poster design in under 15 minutes, including revisions. What traditionally takes days with design agencies or hours with DIY software can be accomplished in minutes with our conversational AI approach, dramatically accelerating your promotional timeline.

items.question: Can I get multiple poster design options to choose from?
items.answer: Absolutely! Many users request several different concepts to compare. Simply ask the AI to generate multiple options or to explore different directions (e.g., "Show me a more vibrant approach" or "Can I see a version with photography instead of illustration?"). This allows you to evaluate different approaches before finalizing.

items.question: How do I get the poster files to my printer or digital platforms?
items.answer: After finalizing your design, you'll receive industry-standard file formats that are accepted by all major printing services and digital platforms. These include high-resolution PDFs for print production and web-optimized JPGs and PNGs for digital distribution—ready to send to your printer or upload to your preferred platforms.

items.question: Can the designs accommodate QR codes or other interactive elements?
items.answer: Yes. Our system understands modern promotional needs and can incorporate interactive elements including QR codes, augmented reality markers, social media handles, hashtags, and other engagement tools while maintaining the visual integrity of your poster design.
